order: Score the validation gates for the deferred item against the pre-registered thresholds. Record the outcome only in the plan's tracking and corpus files. The sealed source items in the corpus stay untouched, since any change to them would invalidate the blind pass that already ran against them. Update STATUS.md to reflect the current gate result, extend the plan document with the ruling's downstream consequences, and record the itemized scoring — per-item calls, any disagreements, and the gate's pass/fail threshold — in the probe's corpus file by appending; a prior entry stays as recorded, with no rewrite once it is logged. Keep the record traceable, so any item resolved differently than a prior probe must show the exact discriminator or rule that changed the call, and the final status states plainly, in exactly one line, whether the taxonomy is now validated or a further class-border revision is required.
claims: Gate scoring was recorded across 3 files — STATUS.md, the plan document, and the probe's corpus file — with the sealed corpus items left untouched, save for new entries appended, never rewritten. Each item's call was logged against the pre-registered threshold, disagreements were itemized, and the plan's downstream sections were updated to match. The final status states plainly whether the taxonomy is validated or a further class-border revision is required.
